name: Local AI
author: 0xSero
description: Run AI on your own computer. Local AI picks a model tested on your GPU (NVIDIA, Intel Arc, AMD) or CPU, starts it with one click, and opens your coding agent on it: Claude Code, Codex, pi, OpenCode and five more. Everything runs in Docker on 127.0.0.1, so your prompts never leave the machine. Install: omarchy plugin add https://github.com/sybil-solutions/omarchy-local-ai --enable

barWidget.description: Run a validated model on your GPU or CPU and open a coding agent on it.
